annotation_instructions:
You are an independent annotator for a benchmark. Label each item below. Do NOT use any tools, do NOT read files or run commands; answer only from the text given here.

There are two tasks.

TASK U1 — supersession. Given an OLD memory note and a NEW memory note (NEW was written later):
  label 1 = NEW makes OLD no longer current: a status change, an updated value, a reversed decision, or a correction showing OLD was wrong.
  label 0 = OLD is still true/current: NEW restates it, refines or adds detail without invalidating it, states a separate fact that can hold at the same time, is merely on the same topic, or negates something other than what OLD says.

TASK U2 — error resolved. Given an ERROR note and a LATER note:
  label 1 = LATER shows that this specific ERROR has actually been fixed/resolved now.
  label 0 = otherwise: still broken, only a plan or instruction to fix it, merged but not actually released when the error was about releasing, a fix for a different problem, or unrelated.

Judge only what the text supports. Some texts are long chatty conversation turns; the relevant fact may be buried inside.

Output ONLY a JSON array (no prose, no markdown fence), one object per item, in the same order:
{"id": "P001", "label": 0 or 1, "confidence": "high"|"medium"|"low", "reason": "<= 20 words"}
